## Pull Request by @mateuszsikora

- added review suggestions from this PR: https://github.com/FluffyLabs/typeberry/pull/758
- added tests to merging accumulate results logic
- fixed merging privileged services

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **Refactor**

## Walkthrough

This change updates parallel accumulation result shapes to readonly tuples [serviceId, { consumedGas, stateUpdate }] and constructs a Map directly from those tuples; when stateUpdate is null it defaults to a checkpoint. accumulateInParallel per-service mapping now emits const tuples. Sequential accumulation aliases and comments were clarified for transfers and yieldedRoot handling. Merging logic in accumulation-result-merge-utils was revised: privilegedServicesUpdatedByManager is introduced and used as the source for registrar/delegator/assigners decisions, updatePrivilegedService return values were swapped, and recomputation of per-core assigners is gated behind a shouldUpdateAssigners flag. A comprehensive new test suite for mergePerallelAccumulationResults was added with builders and many merge-path tests.

## Estimated code review effort

🎯 4 (Complex) | ⏱️ ~45 minutes

- accumulation-result-merge-utils.ts: verify swapped updatePrivilegedService return semantics, correct sourcing from privilegedServicesUpdatedByManager, and gating/tryAsPerCore usage for assigners.
- accumulate/accumulate.ts: confirm tuple-return shape, checkpoint defaulting for null stateUpdate, and Map construction preserves prior semantics (transfers, yieldedRoot handling).
- accumulation-result-merge-utils.test.ts: review extensive builders and test cases for correctness and alignment with intended merging behavior.

## Possibly related PRs

- FluffyLabs/typeberry#500 — modifies accumulate.ts and per-service accumulation result behavior; likely overlaps with tuple/result-shape changes.
- FluffyLabs/typeberry#492 — changes accumulation result representations and merging of stateUpdate.services; strong overlap with merging behavior.
- FluffyLabs/typeberry#758 — updates accumulate and merge logic that intersect with privileged-services and parallel accumulation result handling.
